case_title: DANIEL FRIAS JR VS. SUSANA MARTINEZ

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,900.00 FILED BY FRIAS JR, DANIEL AS TO DEFENDANT MARTINEZ, SUSANA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-01-2013 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. "DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. WRONG VENUE, STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS HAS RUN ON PLAINTIFF'S PERSONAL INJURY CLAIM", PER JUDGE MITCHELL. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE IN OPEN COURT. APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
